title: FEU Bamboo Band to stage ‘Malaya: Songs of Freedom’ concert
summary: The FEU Bamboo Band will celebrate Filipino heritage and the spirit of freedom through “Malaya: Songs of Freedom” on Sept. 26 at the FEU Auditorium in Manila.
